releaseNotes:
• Fixed Payment Order Creation: Seamless UPI payment intent and instant QR generation
• Live Payment Verification: Real-time settlement verification with automated wallet balance crediting
• Unified Academy Subscriptions: Direct backend checkout integration
• Integrated Theme Switcher: Seamless dark & light mode toggling with custom animated switch
• Complete Screen Polish: Modernized card styling, status badges, and enhanced drawer navigation
• Direct Room Credentials & Slot Board: Live room credentials with 1-tap copy and real-time slot tracking
• Enhanced Forced Update Gate: Streamlined in-app update experience with real-time download progress
• Performance & Motion Optimization: Hardware-accelerated motion curves and refined dark/light color palette
